otoroshi.models.SnowMonkeyConfig.description: Settings for the snow monkey (chaos engineering)

dryRun.description: Whether or not outages will actualy impact requests

timesPerDay.description: Number of time per day each service will be outage

startTime.description: Start time of Snow Monkey each day

includeUserFacingDescriptors.description: Whether or not user facing apps. will be impacted by Snow Monkey

targetGroups.description: Groups impacted by Snow Monkey. If empty, all groups will be impacted

enabled.description: Whether or not this config is enabled

stopTime.description: Stop time of Snow Monkey each day

Empty.description: an empty body. Useful for RPC like endpoints

PatchDocument.description: A JSONPatch document as defined by RFC 6902

value.description: The value to be used within the operations.

from.description: A string containing a JSON Pointer value.

OutageStrategy.description: How services are picked for an outage. Replaces the schema generated from the sealed trait, written as a string

UserAnalyticsQueryFilters.description: The data a query runs on. The tenant is not a filter: it always comes from the `Otoroshi-Tenant` header

from.description: The start of the time range (inclusive): `now`, `now-<n><unit>` with a unit among `s`, `m`, `h` and `d` (like `now-30m` or `now-7d`), or an ISO-8601 instant (like `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`). `now-1h` when missing or invalid

to.description: The end of the time range (exclusive): `now`, `now-<n><unit>` with a unit among `s`, `m`, `h` and `d` (like `now-30m` or `now-7d`), or an ISO-8601 instant (like `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`). `now` when missing or invalid

route_id.description: Only keep the requests handled by this route

api_id.description: Only keep the requests handled by this API

apikey_id.description: Only keep the requests made with this API key (client id)

group_id.description: Only keep the requests handled by a route of this group

err.description: Only keep the requests in error (`true`) or the successful ones (`false`)

UserAnalyticsQueryRequest.description: A user analytics query to run

query.description: The id of the query, as listed by `GET /api/analytics/_schema`

params.description: The parameters of the query, as listed in its `params`, like `{"top_n": 10}` for the top N queries

bucket.description: The time bucket size of timeseries and heatmaps: `1m`, `5m`, `1h`, `6h` or `1d`. When missing or unknown, it depends on the time range: up to 1 hour `1m`, up to 24 hours `1h`, up to 7 days `6h`, `1d` beyond

compare.description: Also run the query on the previous period of the same length and return it in `compare`. Ignored by the queries that do not support it (`supports_compare` in the catalog)

nocache.description: Run the query even if its result is in the cache, and do not cache the new one

UserAnalyticsQueryData.description: The result of a query. Its fields depend on `shape`: `scalar` has `value` and `label`, `pie` has `label` and `items` (with `key` and `value`), `topN` has `items` (with `key`, `label` and `value`), `timeseries` has `bucket` and either `points` (one series) or `series` (several named series), `heatmap` has `bucket`, `xBuckets`, `yBuckets` and `values`. The layout of `metric` and `table` results is up to the admin extension providing the query

label.description: The label of a `scalar` or `pie` result

items.description: The items of a `pie` or `topN` result, biggest first

bucket.description: The time bucket size of a `timeseries` or `heatmap` result

points.description: The points of a single series `timeseries` result, one per bucket

series.description: The series of a multi-series `timeseries` result

xBuckets.description: The time buckets of a `heatmap` result (X axis), as unix timestamps in milliseconds

yBuckets.description: The response time ranges of a `heatmap` result (Y axis), from `<50ms` to `>=3s`

values.description: The request counts of a `heatmap` result, one row per `yBuckets` entry and one column per `xBuckets` entry

UserAnalyticsQueryItem.description: An item of a `pie` or `topN` result

key.description: What is counted: a status code, a method, a route id, an API key client id, ...

label.description: A readable name for `key` (the route name for routes, `key` otherwise). `topN` only

ts.description: The start of the time bucket, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

value.description: The value for this time bucket (0 when there is no data)

UserAnalyticsTimeseriesSeries.description: A named series of a multi-series timeseries

name.description: The name of the series, like `p95`, `data_in` or `5xx`

points.description: The points of the series, one per bucket

UserAnalyticsQueryResult.description: The result of a user analytics query

raw.description: The rows behind `data`, when the query provides them. Empty for multi-series timeseries and heatmaps

execution_ms.description: The time it took to run the query, in milliseconds. Missing when the result comes from the cache

from_cache.description: Whether the result, and its comparison when there is one, comes from the 30 seconds result cache

bucket.description: The time bucket size used by the query

UserAnalyticsQueryResponse.description: The result of a user analytics query

raw.description: The rows behind `data`, when the query provides them. Empty for multi-series timeseries and heatmaps

execution_ms.description: The time it took to run the query, in milliseconds. Missing when the result comes from the cache

from_cache.description: Whether the result, and its comparison when there is one, comes from the 30 seconds result cache

bucket.description: The time bucket size used by the query

compare.description: The result of the same query on the previous period of the same length. Only present when `compare` was requested and the query supports it

UserAnalyticsQueryCatalog.description: The queries user analytics can run

widget_types.description: The widget types a dashboard widget can use

UserAnalyticsQueryDefinition.description: A query user analytics can run

id.description: The id to use in `POST /api/analytics/_query` and in dashboard widgets

shape.description: The shape of the result of the query

default_widget.description: The widget type that displays the query by default

supports_compare.description: Whether the query can be compared with the previous period

UserAnalyticsQueryParam.description: A parameter of a user analytics query

name.description: The name of the parameter in `params`

kind.description: The type of the parameter, like `int`

default.description: The value used when the parameter is missing

UserAnalyticsProjection.description: A family of events user analytics can store

id.description: The id of the projection, to use in `excluded_projections`

description.description: The events stored by the projection

core.description: Whether the projection is built into Otoroshi (`false` when an admin extension provides it)

table.description: The table the events are written to

UserAnalyticsExporterSettings.description: The settings of a user-analytics data exporter (its `config`)

uri.description: A PostgreSQL connection URI, like `postgresql://user:password@host:5432/database`. Used instead of the other connection settings when present

user.description: The user connecting to the database

table_prefix.description: The prefix of the table names

pool_size.description: The maximum number of connections to the database

retention_days.description: How long events are kept, in days

statement_timeout_ms.description: The maximum duration of a query, in milliseconds

excluded_projections.description: The ids of the projections that are not stored (see `GET /api/analytics/_projections`)

UserAnalyticsSetActiveExporterResponse.description: The outcome of the activation of a user-analytics data exporter

active.description: The id of the active exporter

demoted_count.description: The number of exporters that were active before

seeded_default.description: The default dashboards that were created

UserAnalyticsRestoreDefaultsResponse.description: The default dashboards that were created

created.description: The default ids of the dashboards that were created

count.description: The number of dashboards that were created

UserAnalyticsAlertEventsPage.description: A page of fired events of a user alert

limit.description: The maximum number of events of the page

UserAnalyticsAlertEvent.description: A time a user alert fired

ts.description: When the alert fired, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

alert_id.description: The id of the user alert

alert_name.description: The name of the user alert when it fired

severity.description: The severity of the user alert, like `info`, `warning` or `critical`

message.description: The message of the user alert

combine.description: How the conditions were combined: `AND` or `OR`

windowSeconds.description: The time window the conditions were evaluated on, in seconds

conditions.description: The evaluation of each condition of the alert

seen_at.description: When the event was acknowledged, as a unix timestamp in milliseconds

UserAnalyticsAlertConditionEval.description: The evaluation of a condition of a user alert

query.description: The id of the query of the condition

reducer.description: How the query result was reduced to a single value: `avg`, `max`, `min`, `sum` or `last`

operator.description: How the value was compared to the threshold: `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `==` or `!=`

error.description: Why the condition could not be evaluated

updated.description: The number of events that were acknowledged
